@pytest.mark.parametrize('mode',['complete','pending_limit','batch_changed','baseline_changed'])
async def test_signup_pending_continues_same_batch_without_second_upload(case,monkeypatch,mode):
    c=case;packet=await lease.acquire(c.worker,dict(request_id=c.rid,job_id=c.jid))
    claim=dict(claim_id='c'*32,file={'path':'original.xlsx'},items=['1'])
    packet.update(operation='signup',claim=claim,write_allowed=True)
    db=c.worker.jobs.db
    db.execute('UPDATE campaign_ui_takeovers SET packet=?',(json.dumps(packet),))
    source=c.worker.output/c.jid;source.mkdir(parents=True)
    baseline=source/'before.json';baseline.write_text('[]')
    monkeypatch.setattr(ops,'guard',AsyncMock())
    from app.engine import campaign_bound_transfers as bound
    verify=AsyncMock(return_value=claim);monkeypatch.setattr(bound,'verified_erp_claim',verify)
    pending=dict(state='unknown',batch='123',reason='official_terminal_not_available_within_180_seconds')
    terminal=dict(state='terminal',batch='123',counts={'total':1,'success':1,'failed':0,'pending':0})
    if mode=='batch_changed':terminal['batch']='456'
    reads=[];writes=[]
    class Driver:
        def __init__(self,*a,**k):pass
        async def await_upload_terminal(self,**kwargs):
            reads.append(kwargs)
            return pending if len(reads)==1 or mode=='pending_limit' else terminal
    monkeypatch.setattr(ops,'CampaignPageIO',Driver)
    async def perform(worker,packet,operation,options,seq):
        if operation=='upload':
            writes.append('original_upload');return dict(state='write_unknown')
        result=await ops.perform_on_page(worker,packet,operation,options,seq,object())
        if 'original_result' in result:return lease.finish_transfer(worker,packet,result['original_result'])
        return result
    monkeypatch.setattr(ops,'perform',perform)
    async def command(name):
        current=lease.status(c.worker,c.jid)
        await lease.handle(c.session,'program_takeover_'+name,dict(job_id=c.jid,sequence=current['sequence']+1))
        await c.session.campaign_takeover_task
        return lease.status(c.worker,c.jid)
    await command('upload')
    first=await command('collect')
    assert first['command']['result'].get('state')=='original_batch_pending',first['command']
    if mode=='baseline_changed':baseline.write_text('[{"changed":true}]')
    second=await command('collect')
    assert writes==['original_upload']
    assert verify.await_args.kwargs=={'existing_job':c.jid}
    assert reads[0]['expected_batch'] is None
    if mode=='complete':
        assert second['state']=='returned' and reads[1]['expected_batch']=='123'
        assert reads[0]['before']==reads[1]['before']==[]
        assert c.worker.jobs.status(c.jid)['result']['batch']=='123'
    elif mode=='pending_limit':
        await command('collect')
        with pytest.raises(SurfaceError,match='already_attempted'):await command('collect')
        assert len(reads)==3
    else:

        assert 'changed' in second['command']['result']['reason']
        with pytest.raises(SurfaceError,match='already_attempted'):await command('collect')
    with pytest.raises(SurfaceError):await command('upload')
